name: Konda
description: Michiko's father, whose crime caused the Kami War; turned to stone and shattered by Kyodai.

description_citations.text: "Toshiro Umezawa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Michiko abandons her father's fortress to consult holy monks and the orochi about the kami's rage.
timeline.quote: abandons the shrinking safety of her father's fortress to consult holy monks and the orochi

citation.text: "Champions of Kamigawa", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Damage from the Apocalypse Chime weakens the veil, letting Konda pull an aspect of O-Kagachi through it and begin the Kami War.
timeline.quote: thus beginning the Kami War .

citation.text: "Kamigawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The enraged kami attack the physical world to reclaim That Which Was Taken, and mortals lose a losing battle.
timeline.quote: Lord Konda's act greatly enraged the spirits, who turned against the physical world with a vengeance.

citation.text: "Kamigawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the war's twentieth year Michiko Konda frees the scion Kyodai and defeats O-Kagachi and Konda; O-Kagachi's death merges the two realms.
timeline.quote: The death of O-Kagachi caused the barrier between the two realms to break down

citation.text: "Kamigawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Takeshi Konda steals the essence of a kami from the Kakuriyo on the night of Michiko's birth, imprisoning it and awakening O-Kagachi, beginning the Kami War.
timeline.quote: this act awoke the prisoner's parent, beginning the Kami War .

citation.text: "Kyodai", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Michiko and Kyodai defeat Konda and O-Kagachi and become guardians of the barrier between realms.
timeline.quote: defeated Konda and O-Kagachi and claimed themselves the guardians of the barrier between the Utsushiyo and the Kakuriyo.

citation.text: "Kyodai", section "Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Michiko's mother dies in childbirth; Konda neglects his daughter, leaving her with Lady Pearl-Ear.
timeline.quote: Her mother died in childbirth

citation.text: "Michiko Konda", section "Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kyodai punishes Konda; the sisters become the new guardians of Kamigawa.
timeline.quote: Kyodai later punished Konda for his crime as well.

citation.text: "Michiko Konda", section "Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lord Konda raids the Spirit World and tears out O-Kagachi's heart, casting it as a stone disk.
timeline.quote: he tore out O-Kagachi's "heart," its divinity

citation.text: "O-Kagachi", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the twentieth year, O-Kagachi first manifests, devouring three thousand warriors and defeating the All-Consuming Oni of Chaos.
timeline.quote: It also defeated Hidetsugu's master, the All-Consuming Oni of Chaos easily.

citation.text: "O-Kagachi", section "First Manifestation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshi steals Konda's stone trophy and escapes the hyozan oath with Night's Reach's help.
timeline.quote: With the Myojin of Night's Reach's help, Toshi was able to escape the bonds of the hyozan oath.

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kyodai turns Konda to stone and shatters him; Hidetsugu emerges merged with the oni and Mochi is eaten.
timeline.quote: Mochi was torn apart and eaten by the oni's jaws.

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: O-Kagachi attacks Eiganjo and the refugees run into the akki army.
timeline.quote: then O-Kagachi attacks Eiganjo.

citation.text: "Heretic: Betrayers of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Isamaru and the wounded Yosei rally the soldiers while an army of twisted ghosts led by a misshapen Takeno rises to aid Konda.
timeline.quote: the appearance of Isamaru and the hurt-but-still-fighting Yosei rallies them.

citation.text: "Heretic: Betrayers of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: O-Kagachi descends on Eiganjo Castle, rips Yosei in half and ruins the castle.
timeline.quote: One of O-Kagachi's heads caught Yosei in its jaws and ripped him in half

citation.text: "O-Kagachi", section "Attack on Eiganjo". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshiro Umezawa teleports into Konda's sanctum and steals the Taken One during the chaos.
timeline.quote: He stole the Taken One from the pedestal

citation.text: "O-Kagachi", section "Attack on Eiganjo". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: O-Kagachi senses the Taken One's absence and retreats, leaving Konda's kingdom in ruins.
timeline.quote: leaving in its wake the ruins of Konda's kingdom

citation.text: "O-Kagachi", section "Attack on Eiganjo". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshi uses Night's Reach's powers to chase off the Oni of Chaos at Minamo, drawing Hidetsugu's ire as Konda's ghost army attacks.
timeline.quote: Luckily at that moment Konda and his ghost army attack Minamo

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Konda arrives at Jukai and the Taken One summons O-Kagachi; Toshi teleports the Taken One through Night's Reach's realm against her command.
timeline.quote: he teleports the Taken One through Night's Reach's realm

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Michiko and Kyodai merge and defeat O-Kagachi, biting off his last heads; Konda is turned to stone and shattered.
timeline.quote: Konda then shows up but is quickly turned to stone and shattered

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: His research for Konda makes him indirectly responsible for Konda's crime, the Kami War and Iron-Claw's death.
timeline.quote: he became indirectly responsible for Konda's crime and the Kami War

citation.text: "Eight-and-a-Half-Tails", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Godo wages a guerilla war against Konda.
timeline.quote: waged a guerilla war against Konda for almost ten years

citation.text: "Godo", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The kami begin to take form in the material world while Konda's armies secure territory.
timeline.quote: Even as his armies and samurai secured more territory in Konda's name, the kami manifested in ever-greater numbers.

citation.text: "Kamigawa". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Konda remains mysteriously safe within his stronghold throughout the siege.
timeline.quote: Throughout this siege, Konda remained within his stronghold, mysteriously safe from harm.

citation.text: "Kamigawa". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: It is revealed that Konda began the war by kidnapping a kami, with moonfolk aid, to secure his own power and immortality.
timeline.quote: With aid from moonfolk allies, Konda kidnapped a kami to secure his own power and immortality.

citation.text: "Kamigawa". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: During the Kami War era, Mochi and the soratami secretly plot to make the soratami dominant by manipulating Konda into inciting war between mortals and kami; the effort fails.
timeline.quote: However, these efforts would ultimately fail.

citation.text: "Moonfolk", section "Kamigawa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At age 34 Takeno is given command of Konda's forces.
timeline.quote: Takeno was given command of Daimyo Konda's forces

citation.text: "Munetsugu Takeno", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: When O-Kagachi attacks Eiganjo, Takeno shields Konda from a rock and is impaled.
timeline.quote: Takeno leaped in the way of a huge flying sliver of rock

citation.text: "Munetsugu Takeno", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamigawa's denizens pray to the Myojin at the start of the Kami War, but the Myojin, in chaos over Konda's crime, turn against the material world like the other kami.
timeline.quote: like all other kami, the Myojin turned against the material world

citation.text: "Myojin", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Pearl-Ear is present at Michiko's birth and brings the news to Konda, who is behaving strangely; she flees in fear.
timeline.quote: she felt a terrible portent from his words and the mood of the room and fled from there in fear

citation.text: "Pearl-Ear", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Pearl-Ear is imprisoned and then banished from Eiganjo.
timeline.quote: she was eventually banished from Eiganjo altogether

citation.text: "Pearl-Ear", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Pearl-Ear witnesses O-Kagachi's appearance, the climactic battle and the Daimyo's fate.
timeline.quote: She witnessed the climactic battle above the boughs, as well as the Daimyo's ultimate fate.

citation.text: "Pearl-Ear", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: As a young man Konda built Eiganjo Castle, drove out bandits and united local warlords.
timeline.quote: Konda built Eiganjo Castle , drove out the surrounding bandits

citation.text: "Takeshi Konda", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Konda performed a sacrilegious ritual breaking the barrier between mortal and spirit worlds and imprisoned a major spirit, gaining immortality.
timeline.quote: he broke the barrier between the mortal and spirit worlds

citation.text: "Takeshi Konda", section "Konda's Crime". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Konda's crime triggered the Kami War.
timeline.quote: Konda's crime triggered the Kami War

citation.text: "Takeshi Konda", section "Konda's Crime". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the climax of the war Konda and O-Kagachi were struck down by their daughters Michiko and Kyodai.
timeline.quote: Konda and O-Kagachi were struck down by their daughters

citation.text: "Takeshi Konda", section "The Reckoning". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Taken One punctured Konda's eyes, petrified him and crushed him into a million pieces.
timeline.quote: the Taken One punctured Konda's eyes, then petrified his immortal body and crushed him into a million pieces

citation.text: "Takeshi Konda", section "The Reckoning". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
